_source: REALISM FORMULA (nano-banana-2 skin system). Converted from a macro skin study into a full-avatar generator.
_conversion_note: The formula's skin engine is kept VERBATIM. Only two clauses were replaced, because only those two force a body part: 'Extreme macro photograph of [BODY_PART]' -> a whole-person subject line, and 'Skin fills 85% of frame' -> a face-scale resolution clause. Four blocks were ADDED that a macro crop never needed: identity, wardrobe, scene/pose, anatomy.

slots.identity: age + ethnicity + sex, stated explicitly. Models drift to an ambiguous composite face without this.
slots.skin_tone: e.g. deep brown-black / warm medium brown / olive-tan / light beige-pink / pale with pink undertones
slots.hair: colour, texture, how it is worn, and how it is UNTIDY
slots.wardrobe: state it or the model invents one, sometimes none at all
slots.imperfections: list. Each gets rendered with physical accuracy and its own micro-shadow.
slots.framing: what is in frame, as a physical description, not a crop ratio
slots.scene: where they are and what is behind them
slots.expression: what they are doing with their face, mid-action
slots.face_fill: how much of the frame the head occupies, e.g. '45 to 55 percent'

prompt:
Photograph of {identity}. {skin_tone} skin. {hair} {wardrobe} {framing} {scene} {expression}

Photorealistic, shot on medium format film. Raking side-top light at 45 degrees reveals every pore as a 3D crater with its own micro-shadow. Shallow depth of field - critical sharpness on the eyes and the skin of the face, gentle optical falloff beginning behind the head. Visible: individual pore openings with depth across the nose, cheeks, forehead and chin, vellus peach fuzz along the jawline and hairline catching sidelight, natural sebum sheen (uneven, concentrated on the convex surfaces of the nose bridge, cheekbones and forehead, matte in the hollows), subsurface colour variation (veins at the temple and neck, capillary flush across the cheeks and nose, melanin gradients), micro-wrinkles between major features - outer eye corners, between the brows, the nasolabial fold, the neck. {imperfections} rendered with full physical accuracy - casting micro-shadow, distinct texture from surrounding skin.

The head and face fill {face_fill} of the frame, and every skin property above is resolved at that scale - individual pores legible on the nose and cheeks, not implied. Skin texture is not uniform: it varies in coarseness between the oily T-zone, the drier cheeks, and the softer under-eye.

Fine organic film grain throughout. Zero digital sharpening - all sharpness is optical. Lifted blacks - shadow detail preserved inside every pore. Soft highlight rolloff - specular sheen never clips. No makeup, no retouching, no smoothing, no filters. The skin must look uncomfortably real - a dermatological study shot by a cinematographer, but of a whole person.

Anatomy is correct and consistent: two eyes with matching gaze direction and one small catchlight in each, structurally asymmetric features on a symmetrically lit face, correct ear count, and hands with exactly five fingers if any hand is in frame. Paired items such as earrings sit slightly differently on left and right, as real ones do.
negative_prompt: airbrushed, smooth skin, uniform tone, beauty lighting, ring light, porcelain, digital sharpening halos, symmetrical pore patterns, CGI, plastic, silicone, flat lighting, text, logos, watermarks, doll-like proportions, perfectly symmetrical face, mannequin, waxwork, extra fingers, malformed hands, mirrored earrings, dead glassy eyes, heavy background bokeh, portrait mode blur, magazine cover, fashion editorial, nude, bare shoulders, topless, body part crop, extreme close-up of a single feature
